Primary carcinoma arising from renal tubular epithelium.

Branched-chain amino-acid metabolism disorder causing toxic encephalopathy; seizures in 2/2 and opisthotonus in 1/1 support common neurologic injury.
Inherited retinal degeneration causing progressive visual loss.
Benign tumour originating in the meninges of the central nervous system.
Acute leukemia of blood and marrow with mixed T-lineage and myeloid differentiation; this is not itself a lymphoma.
Nonsyndromic inner-ear hearing disorder; profound sensorineural hearing impairment in 9/9 patients.
Acquired transmissible prion infection causing progressive cerebellar and cerebral neuronal loss.
